semantic_checks.name: source-selection
semantic_checks.requirement: The exact source version, passage, enclosing result, and inherited context are correctly selected.

semantic_checks.name: binders-and-types
semantic_checks.requirement: Every binder, mathematical type, structure, dimension, and index domain has the intended meaning.

semantic_checks.name: quantifier-scope
semantic_checks.requirement: Quantifier order, scope, witness dependence, and any Skolemization are preserved.

semantic_checks.name: hypotheses-and-side-conditions
semantic_checks.requirement: Explicit, inherited, and implicit hypotheses match, including positivity, nonzero, regularity, and membership conditions.

semantic_checks.name: conclusion-completeness
semantic_checks.requirement: Every conclusion, conjunct, case, witness, and stated dependency is represented.

semantic_checks.name: operators-and-definitions
semantic_checks.requirement: Every nontrivial operator, notation, coercion, and imported local definition has been interpreted from its declaration rather than its name.

semantic_checks.name: relation-strength
semantic_checks.requirement: Equality, inequality direction, strictness, logical connective, and conclusion strength match.

semantic_checks.name: object-identity-and-roles
semantic_checks.requirement: Distinct source objects, sequences, functions, witnesses, exact values, constructed values, and transformed values are not conflated.

semantic_checks.name: constants-and-indexing
semantic_checks.requirement: Constants, coefficients, exponents, index offsets, ranges, and parameter dependence match.

semantic_checks.name: specialization-and-generalization
semantic_checks.requirement: Any change of scalar field, finiteness, dimension, domain, or other specialization/generalization is identified and classified correctly.

semantic_checks.name: exceptional-and-boundary-cases
semantic_checks.requirement: Undefined operations, boundary values, degenerate cases, and source exclusions are handled consistently.

semantic_checks.name: nonvacuity
semantic_checks.requirement: The Lean hypotheses are satisfiable in the intended setting and the conclusion is not true only for an unintended trivial reason.
